text:
julia_events: Heads up — we're confirmed for the Seattle ML Breakfast on May 12. Small table + 20-min lightning talk slot. Need: speaker submission copy, 30-40 swag items (compact), lead-routing plan, and AV checklist. Who can own what?

kate_design: I can take swag design. Thinking 200 stickers, 50 postcard-sized one-pagers, and 40 mini-notebooks (small run). Can we do eco paper notebooks? Budget check. :recycle:

maria_marketing: I'll draft the event post + speaker blurb. Will need the 2-line TL;DR and a 2-paragraph speaker bio by EOD Wed. Also need the PR/partner list for pre-event outreach.

ev an_gmt: @evan_gtm: (typo) I'll handle lead routing. Plan: QR -> short demo sandbox with UTM params -> HubSpot form that maps to MQL queue. Need someone to confirm the redirect URL and the demo access token rotation window. Also propose a scan fallback sheet for low-connectivity.

sam_sde: I can build the lightweight demo sandbox and short-lived invite token. Suggest token TTL = 24h and a pre-warmed container so first demo doesn't cold-start. For QR landing page: /sea-breakfast?src=qr&utm_campaign=sea_ml_breakfast_2026

kate_design: Swag note: if we do notebooks, lead time is 14 days for the eco paper supplier. If order placed by Tue we'll get them. Stickers are 5 days. Postcards same.

kiran_ops: Shipping address and onsite pickup window confirmed: Event Hall — East Lobby, 7:00–8:00 AM May 12. Pickup tel: +1-206-555-0184. Vendor drop-off docs attached to the organizer portal. Also we have 1 table (6ft) and 1 power strip. AV: projector available for the talk, laptop HDMI only.

julia_events: For speaker submission — I'll write the outline but need the final deck by May 5. Speaker: @maria_marketing (you OK presenting?), 15 min talk + 5 Q&A. If Maria can't, nominate someone.

maria_marketing: Happy to do it. Will send bio + 2-line TL;DR by tomorrow. Will keep slides to 8-10 slides. Topic: "Serving LLMs at product scale: lessons on latency and cost"

ev an_gmt: For lead routing details: HubSpot pipeline stage = Event > Qualified > Demo Booked. Use property 'event_source' = 'sea_breakfast_2026'. Can we add a hidden fallback field 'lead_capture_method' with values 'qr' or 'paper'?

sam_sde: Yes, the QR form will POST to our endpoint which writes to HubSpot via the Events API. I'll include the hidden fields. Also can generate printable QR (PNG) for the table.

kate_design: Design asks: need logo in vector, color palette, and a 3x3 inch sticker art by Thu. Who has final logos? @julia_events?

julia_events: Logo files are in Drive: /Marketing/Assets/Logos/rebrand_v2. Use the 'stacked' mark for small stickers.

boothbot: SHIPPING REMINDER: cut-off for ground ship (13 days) vs expedited (5 days). Order asap for notebooks.

kiran_ops: AV checklist: bring HDMI dongle (we have 1 but bring spare), speaker clicker, extension cord, laptop charger. Table skirt not provided. Plan to bring a small riser for the postcards.

ev an_gmt: Post-event follow-up: automated email day+1 to all QR scans + handwritten postcards to high-intent leads (HubSpot score > 70). Sales owner for the event: @logan_sales — Logan will get the MQL queue. Logan, you comfortable?

julia_events: @logan_sales not in thread — ping him after.

maria_marketing: Copy for the event post draft (quick):
"Join Redwood Inference at the Seattle ML Breakfast on May 12. Maria Martin will share practical strategies to keep inference fast and affordable in production. Stop by our table for a demo and an exclusive notebook"

kate_design: Looks good — I'll lay it out for social. Also mockups for the postcard front/back by Fri.

sam_sde: Demo quickstart copy (for QR landing):
"1) Click 'Try Demo' 2) Use preloaded prompt 3) See latency + cost breakdown 4) Schedule a 1:1"

maria_marketing: Also let's test the demo QR and HubSpot write flow by Tue 9 AM PST. @sam_sde can you spin up a test token and post the QR?

sam_sde: Yep, will deploy test token by Mon EOD and post QR in #marketing then.

kiran_ops: One more: travel reimbursements — event max meal per diem $35, receipts required. Submit via Expensify and tag 'SEA-event-2026'.

julia_events: Great progress. Action items summary:
- @kate_design: finalize swag mockups + order by Tue noon (notebooks need expedited if late)
- @maria_marketing: speaker bio + final copy by Wed EOD
- @sam_sde: demo sandbox + test QR by Mon/Tue
- @evan_gmt: HubSpot mapping + fallback sheet design
- @kiran_ops: shipping + AV logistics, bring spare dongle
- @logan_sales: own MQL queue (will ping separately)

Please update when you pick up your item. :thumbsup:
